controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Colour from a measured spectrum of the star (HST/STIS). The disc is unresolved; its darker edge follows a model limb-darkening law, not a measurement.
controls.notes: The colour of Polaris's HST/STIS spectrum. Hubble observed it on 20 September 2001; Polaris pulsates slightly over four days, so this is one moment of that cycle. No resolved image of the surface is cast here.
